summary: Project includes a waitlist signup flow; email submission is failing due to email-sending not enabled, so the plan is to switch waitlist signups to on-chain/canister storage and allow admin to access/copy signups.
architectural_notes: Waitlist submissions should be persisted in canister/on-chain storage to avoid reliance on external email sending.
known_issues: Waitlist form email submission fails when email sending is not enabled, preventing signups from being processed.

new_feature_requests.summary: Change waitlist signup to store submissions in canister/on-chain storage instead of sending email
Add admin capability to view and copy/export stored waitlist signups
